panels.title: Estimated plan capacity · list-price USD
panels.description: Estimated capacity of each plan's windows, in list-price USD: the highest estimate among the plan's accounts, since use of a key outside this sub2api only lowers an account's estimate. Providers that report no plan name (e.g. Kimi) are estimated per account and not listed here. A different model mix or peak-hour multipliers shift these values.

targets.expr: count by (provider, plan) (max by (provider, account_id, account_name, plan) (llm_quota_plan_info{plan!="", job="llm_usage"}) and on (provider, account_id, account_name) max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{window=~"5h|weekly", job="llm_usage"}))
max by (provider, plan) (llm_quota:plan_capacity_usd:max{window="5h", job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, plan) (llm_quota:plan_capacity_usd:max{window="weekly", job="llm_usage"})

options.content:
**How the estimate works.** Providers report only the share of a window used. Right after each quota fetch the exporter sums what sub2api logged for the key since that window started (reset time minus 5h or 7 days, which also covers windows that start at first use); usage / share is one sample of the capacity. Prometheus pools the samples (7 days for 5h, 28 days for weekly), and a plan's capacity is the highest among its accounts.

Values are **list-price USD**, not the provider's unit: a different model mix or peak-hour multipliers shift them. Monthly windows are not estimated. The *per fetch* charts in History show how steady the samples are.

panels.title: Usage by provider · trailing 1d / 7d / 30d
panels.description: From sub2api usage_logs: every account that served requests, grouped by provider (the quota provider for tracked accounts, otherwise the sub2api platform). Tokens include input, output, cache writes and cache reads. Value is the list price of those tokens (usage_logs.total_cost, USD) before any group rate multiplier. These panels show fixed trailing windows and ignore the time picker. Windows are trailing, to the hour: 1d is this hour plus the 23 before it.

targets.expr: sum by (provider) (llm_usage_requests{window="1d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_tokens{window="1d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_cost_usd{kind="total", window="1d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_requests{window="7d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_tokens{window="7d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_cost_usd{kind="total", window="7d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_requests{window="30d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_tokens{window="30d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider) (llm_usage_cost_usd{kind="total", window="30d", job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: 5h implied capacity · per-fetch samples (USD)
panels.description: Capacity implied by each quota fetch alone: list-price USD logged since the 5h window started, divided by the share used (only at 10% used or more). Steady lines mean a steady estimate; a line that drops suggests use of the key outside this sub2api, one that jumps a plan change.

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_window_consumed{window="5h", unit="usd", job="llm_usage"}) / (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{window="5h", job="llm_usage"}) >= 0.1) > 0

panels.title: Weekly implied capacity · per-fetch samples (USD)
panels.description: Capacity implied by each quota fetch alone: list-price USD logged since the weekly window started, divided by the share used (only at 10% used or more). Steady lines mean a steady estimate; a line that drops suggests use of the key outside this sub2api, one that jumps a plan change.

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_window_consumed{window="weekly", unit="usd", job="llm_usage"}) / (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_used_ratio{window="weekly", job="llm_usage"}) >= 0.1) > 0

panels.title: Balance (CNY)
panels.description: Total balance in CNY; reported by DeepSeek.

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_balance{kind="total", currency="CNY", job="llm_usage"})

defaults.noValue: No account here reports a CNY balance

panels.title: Balance (USD)
panels.description: Total balance in USD; reported by DeepSeek, Command Code and Cline.

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_balance{kind="total", currency="USD", job="llm_usage"})

defaults.noValue: No account here reports a USD balance

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Fetch details per account. Data age is how old the numbers are; HTTP is the last upstream status (0 = no response).

targets.expr: max by (provider, account_id, account_name, platform, status, schedulable) (llm_quota_account_info{job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name, plan) (llm_quota_plan_info{job="llm_usage"})

(max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_key_blacklisted{job="llm_usage"}) == 1) * 2 or (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_endpoint_supported{job="llm_usage"}) == 0) + 3 or max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_up{job="llm_usage"})
time() - max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="llm_usage"})
max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_last_http_status{job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: Usage by account · trailing 1d / 7d / 30d
panels.description: From sub2api usage_logs: every account that served requests, grouped by provider (the quota provider for tracked accounts, otherwise the sub2api platform). Tokens include input, output, cache writes and cache reads. Value is the list price of those tokens (usage_logs.total_cost, USD) before any group rate multiplier. These panels show fixed trailing windows and ignore the time picker. Accounts with no requests in the longest window still show, with zeros.

targets.expr: sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_requests{window="1d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_tokens{window="1d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_cost_usd{kind="total", window="1d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_requests{window="7d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_tokens{window="7d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_cost_usd{kind="total", window="7d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_requests{window="30d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_tokens{window="30d", job="llm_usage"})
sum by (provider, account_name, account_id) (llm_usage_cost_usd{kind="total", window="30d", job="llm_usage"})

panels.title: Fetch status
panels.description: Per-account fetch result over time. No API: the account's host (a relay) has no balance endpoint.

targets.expr: (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_key_blacklisted{job="llm_usage"}) == 1) * 2 or (max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_endpoint_supported{job="llm_usage"}) == 0) + 3 or max by (provider, account_id, account_name) (llm_quota_up{job="llm_usage"})
